title: BKT-like Correlation Scaling and Twist Responses in a One-Dimensional Fractional $U(1)$ Ginzburg--Landau Model
summary: We study a one-dimensional fractional $U(1)$ Ginzburg--Landau model whose quadratic part has Fourier multiplier $|k|^σ$, focusing on the marginal case $σ=1$. This dispersion yields logarithmic spin-wave fluctuations, suggesting BKT-like behavior despite the one-dimensional setting. We sample the equilibrium Gibbs measure using stochastic Gross--Pitaevskii dynamics and analyze correlation functions, dimensionless ratios, effective exponents, and twist responses.
